sentences.text: No; for a Tier 3 UCB, a floating-rate business loan to an MSE with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh cannot have a pre-payment charge.
The applicable UCB directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on such loans.
The bank’s own loan-agreement wording saying a pre-payment charge is payable is inconsistent with the applicable UCB directions for this case.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions were superseded and are no longer in force on the as-of date.
